Group 14: Elements of Group 14 were treated as tetracoor- dinate. Concerning the homonuclear E–E distances we in- clude, in addition to molecular data, solid diamond, Si, Ge, and grey tin. As noted by Pauling on p. 247 of reference [2], the E–E’ distance in SiC is anomalously short. He attributed it to an ionic contribution. Another reason could be the in- volvement of Si d orbitals. We omit SiC. More generally this anomalous shortness affects the bonds in the neighborhood (Si, P, S)–(O, F). Pitzer[33] evoked differences in core repul- sion between 2nd-row (2s2p) and 3rd-row (3s3p) elements, to explain it.
